what:
Alpaca trade-scoped PARTIAL close is refused while sibling tranches' protective legs hold all shares. AlpacaClient._close_partial (DELETE /v2/positions/{sym}?qty=N) deliberately pre-cancels nothing, so on a symbol with several open journal rows each carrying its own bracket, qty_available is 0 and the venue refuses 'insufficient qty available' (logged loudly, no over-close, no naked position). Happens intraday today with DAY legs; PR #13047 (GTC entry legs, HELD) extends it past the RTH close. Candidate fix (Tier-3, order path): cancel only the legs whose qty equals the closing trade's qty (the same identification heuristic modify_protective uses) before the partial DELETE, re-arming the remainder on failure.
